family_rationale.absent_ambiguous_changed_deleted_stale: Non-floor controls: two absent questions with no matching metadata, two ambiguous questions with two equal legitimate files, two declared binding-privacy refusals, and two deliberately unsupported modes with per-arm capability expectations.
family_rationale.behavior_without_exact_symbol: A caller describes what code does in domain words that overlap the function name and path but never state the symbol; the defining file is found from that metadata, not from body-only facts.
family_rationale.code_plus_design_or_message_context: A caller needs both the standalone design section (heading-derived doc.section) and the separate code file implementing it; the heading text and the function name share the distinguishing term. Design documents only, no messages.
family_rationale.exact_symbol_and_partial_name: A caller remembers a whole function name or a contiguous fragment of one; the defining code file is identified by its function-name and path metadata.
family_rationale.relevant_tests_for_behavior: A caller wants the test source covering a behavior; the test file path tests/test_NAME.py and function test_NAME carry the behavior words, and the target is the test file rather than the code under test.
